targets.label: deterministic_loop_not_orchestrator_agent
targets.description: Coordination/routing is owned by a deterministic calibration runtime rather than a learned LLM orchestrator that can freely invent the workflow.

targets.label: bounded_explicit_resources
targets.description: RND, NETA and SCAFFOLD are explicit bounded resources selected through routing; resource identity and allowed invocation are represented rather than silently delegated between agents.

targets.label: validate_task_contract_before_execution
targets.description: A calibration task is structurally validated before live execution, including required decision/telos/current-state/resource/budget fields, rather than allowing malformed work requests into the loop.

targets.label: semantic_adapter_output_validation
targets.description: Provider/adapter outputs must satisfy resource- and phase-specific semantic JSON contracts; malformed or adapter-failed output is surfaced as execution failure rather than coerced into a plausible answer.

targets.label: boundary_can_stop_instead_of_invent
targets.description: Missing/unauthorized resources or unresolved authority/evidence boundaries can halt or defer execution rather than being filled with invented evidence or unauthorized resolution.

targets.label: material_delta_not_invocation_or_agreement
targets.description: Delta accounting distinguishes a resource call or agreement from an observed material change; materiality depends on recorded observed-delta dimensions rather than mere invocation.

targets.label: terminal_stop_states_first_class
targets.description: Stop/failure outcomes such as pending resource, authority stop and failed execution are first-class runtime outcomes rather than exceptions hidden behind a nominal success result.

targets.label: durable_execution_trace_lineage
targets.description: The runtime preserves a durable execution trace containing routing/calls/deltas/decision or equivalent lineage needed to inspect what happened instead of returning only a final prose answer.
